risks.title: Unfavorable macroeconomic and geopolitical conditions
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned first in the risk factors, the language is strong (material adverse impact, negatively impact). Macroeconomic conditions (demand, currencies, inflation, supply chains, tariffs) and geopolitical factors are presented as an ongoing and volatile threat to operations.

risks.title: High dependence on major customers
risks.score_rationale: This risk is detailed with precise figures (53% of revenue from 10 customers, 30% from Walmart). The language is strong (substantially reduce, material adverse effect). The loss or failure of a major customer would have a significant impact.

risks.title: Supply chain and shipping disruptions
risks.score_rationale: This risk is described with high intensity (material adverse effect, harm our results). It details impacts on lead times, costs, and the ability to meet demand, with potential consequences on orders and reputation.

risks.title: Helly Hansen acquisition integration and synergies
risks.score_rationale: This risk is specific to the recent Helly Hansen acquisition. The language is cautious (no assurance, may not realize). It details potential integration difficulties, unforeseen costs, and the realization of expected benefits.

risks.title: Intense competition and evolving consumer preferences
risks.score_rationale: This risk is presented as fundamental to the company's success (success depends on). The language is strong (material adverse effect). It emphasizes the need to adapt quickly to trends and face intense competition, including retailer private-label brands.

risks.title: Margin and profitability pressure
risks.score_rationale: This risk is directly linked to market conditions (increasing pressure on margins). The language is clear (profitability will decline, material adverse effect). It lists pressure factors: competition, costs, tariffs, demand.

risks.title: Financial difficulties of retail customers
risks.score_rationale: This risk relates to the health of the retail sector (retail industry has experienced financial difficulty). The language is significant (material adverse effect, higher credit risk). It highlights the risk of customer payment defaults.
